bundle_planning_check_desc: Before the deadline, a window asks the manager whether tomorrow's shifts are correct; once approved, the PDF goes to the boss.
notif_planning_check_failed_body: The PDF of the schedule of :date (:store) could not be sent: retry from the history.
notif_planning_check_overdue_body: The schedule of :date (:store) was not submitted by the deadline.
notif_planning_check_submitted_body: The schedule of :date (:store) is submitted and awaits your approval.
notif_planning_check_validated_body: The schedule of :date (:store) is approved and sent to the boss.
planning_check_approve_send: Approve and send the PDF to the boss
planning_check_confirm_empty: No shift tomorrow: I confirm the store is not working.
planning_check_disabled_hint: The check is disabled for this store: enable it in the settings.
planning_check_err_bad_status: This check is no longer in the expected state.
planning_check_err_no_recipients: No valid recipient: tick employees in the settings.
planning_check_err_no_shifts: No shift tomorrow: tick the "store closed" confirmation to submit anyway.
planning_check_err_not_enabled: The schedule check is not enabled for this store.
planning_check_err_pdf_failed: The PDF could not be generated.
planning_check_err_reason_required: A reason for rejecting is required.
planning_check_err_recipient_invalid: An e-mail address is not valid.
planning_check_err_recipients_required: Tick at least one recipient to enable the check.
planning_check_err_send_failed: Sending the PDF failed: try again later.
planning_check_err_window_order: The display start time must be before the deadline.
planning_check_flash_rejected: Schedule rejected: the submitter has been notified.
planning_check_flash_submitted: Schedule submitted: an approver will check it.
planning_check_flash_test_no_email: Your account has no valid e-mail address.
planning_check_flash_test_sent: Test PDF sent to your address.
planning_check_mail_intro: Please find attached the schedule of :store for :date.
planning_check_resend_new: Generate a new PDF and send it
planning_check_resend_new_confirm: Generate a new PDF from the current schedule and send it to the recipients?
planning_check_recheck_confirm: Reopen tomorrow's check? It goes back to pending and the check window opens again with tomorrow's shifts; submitting it creates a new report.
planning_check_flash_recheck: The check window is open again: review tomorrow's shifts.
planning_check_send_now_confirm: Generate the PDF from the current schedule and send it to the recipients now?
planning_check_send_now_confirm_empty: There is no shift tomorrow. Send the PDF anyway?
planning_check_tomorrow_empty_hint: No shift is scheduled for tomorrow.
planning_check_setting_deadline_hint: Without a submission by then, approvers and Owners are notified (no PDF is sent).
planning_check_setting_enabled_hint: Ask every day to approve the next day's schedule for this store.
planning_check_setting_open_shifts: Include unassigned open shifts in the PDF
planning_check_setting_recipients_hint: Tick the store employees who receive the validated planning (at most 10). Each one gets their own e-mail with the PDF attached.
planning_check_setting_legacy_recipients: These addresses are not linked to an account of the store. Untick one to remove it; none can be added any more, pick employees instead.
planning_check_err_recipient_unknown: A chosen employee is not part of the store.
planning_check_setting_weekdays_hint: The target day is tomorrow: untick the days the store is closed.
planning_check_setting_window_hint: Store local time from which the window appears.
planning_check_test_hint: Sends tomorrow's schedule as it is now, to your address only.
